question: Who among the following was the Chief Guest in the Republic Day Parade organised at Rajpath in the year 1955?
solution:
The correct answer is __**General Malik Ghulam Muhammad**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **General Malik Ghulam Muhammad, **who was the Governor-General of Pakistan,** was the Chief Guest at India's Republic Day Parade in 1955.**
 
• **Ghulam Muhammad Malik (also called G.M. Malik) is a Pakistani former military officer who commanded the 10 Corps, Rawalpindi of the Pakistan Army. **
 
• 1</strong&
